# Ziaee Denture Clinic — Expanded Information

> A self-contained collection of public clinic and service information, reviewed on 2026-10-13.

Website: https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/

These are edited summaries of the linked public pages, not a verbatim archive of the whole website. They contain no patient records. Current appointment availability, fees and service-specific coverage are confirmed with the clinic. Individual treatment recommendations require assessment.

---

## Ziaee Denture Clinic

> Denture care at 2677 Kingsway in Vancouver, British Columbia, with complete, partial and implant-supported dentures and ongoing denture maintenance services.

Source page: https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/

Content reviewed: 2026-10-13

Ziaee Denture Clinic provides personalized denture care from its Vancouver clinic. The website identifies Mohammad Kabir Ziaee as its owner and licensed denturist. The clinic offers assessment, fitting and follow-up care for people seeking new dentures or help with existing dentures.

The service range includes complete dentures, partial dentures, implant-supported dentures, relines, rebases, repairs, adjustments, digital dentures, custom night guards and sports mouthguards. Digital scanning and design are described alongside traditional techniques. The treatment method is selected following assessment.

The website promotes free consultation requests through its contact form or by telephone. A form submission is a request for the clinic to contact the patient about availability, rather than confirmation of a reserved appointment. The clinic states that it welcomes eligible Canadian Dental Care Plan patients and can help explain coverage and costs.

### Practical details

- Clinic address: 2677 Kingsway, Vancouver, BC, Canada.
- Telephone: 604-326-0459.
- Published hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Saturday is by appointment. Contact the clinic to confirm current availability.
- Languages listed for Mohammad Kabir Ziaee: English, Farsi, Pashto, Hindi, Punjabi and Urdu.
- Treatment suitability, fees, coverage and timelines are confirmed with the clinic.

### Common questions

#### Where is the clinic located?

The published address is 2677 Kingsway in Vancouver, British Columbia.

#### How can I request a consultation?

Call 604-326-0459 or use the appointment enquiry form on the contact page. The clinic will respond about availability.

#### Does the clinic welcome CDCP patients?

The website states that eligible CDCP patients are welcome. Ask the clinic to check coverage and explain any patient charges before treatment.

### Service pages

- [Complete Dentures](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/complete-dentures): Custom complete dentures to replace a full upper or lower arch of missing teeth.
- [Partial Dentures](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/partial-dentures): Custom removable partial dentures for people who have missing teeth and retain some natural teeth.
- [Implant-Supported Dentures](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/implant-supported-dentures): Custom dentures that attach to implants, with the denture pathway coordinated with dental surgeons.
- [Denture Relines](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/relines): Assessment and adjustment of the fitting surface of an existing denture, with hard and soft reline options described.
- [Denture Rebase](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/rebase): Replacement of an existing denture's base while retaining its teeth when the appliance is suitable for rebasing.
- [Denture Repairs](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/denture-repairs): Professional repair enquiries for damaged denture bases, teeth and clasps, including additions to suitable partial dentures.
- [Denture Adjustments](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/adjustments): Assessment and adjustment of pressure points, bite and appliance fit for denture comfort.
- [Custom Night Guards](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/night-guards): Custom-fitted night guard appliances, with design and fit assessed by the clinic.
- [Custom Sports Mouthguards](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/sports-mouthguard): Custom-fitted sports mouthguards for youth and adult athletes.
- [Digital Dentures](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/digital-dentures): Dentures designed using digital scanning and computerized design, with manufacturing methods described on the clinic's service page.

[Clinic contact and consultation enquiries](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/contact-us)

## About Ziaee Denture Clinic

> The clinic's approach to denture care and its owner and licensed denturist, Mohammad Kabir Ziaee.

Source page: https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/about-us

Content reviewed: 2026-10-13

The About page identifies Mohammad Kabir Ziaee as the clinic owner and a licensed denturist. It describes a care approach based on discussing the patient's concerns, reviewing denture history and explaining the proposed treatment.

The clinic describes digital scanning, 3D design, precision milling and traditional impressions among its techniques. The choice of technique and treatment depends on the assessment. The page emphasizes patient communication and explaining costs and coverage before work begins.

### Practical details

- The clinician's listed languages are English, Farsi, Pashto, Hindi, Punjabi and Urdu.
- Consultation enquiries can be made through the website or by calling 604-326-0459.

[Clinic contact and consultation enquiries](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/contact-us)

## Contact and Consultation Requests

> Clinic address, telephone and consultation enquiry form for Ziaee Denture Clinic in Vancouver.

Source page: https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/contact-us

Content reviewed: 2026-10-13

Patients can call 604-326-0459 or use the contact page to ask about denture services, consultation availability or coverage. The published clinic address is 2677 Kingsway, Vancouver, BC.

The website's enquiry form includes options for complete dentures, partial dentures, repairs and relines, rebases and CDCP consultation. The clinic contacts the enquirer to discuss the request. Current opening arrangements and appointment times should be checked directly with the clinic.

### Practical details

- Published weekday hours: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday to Friday.
- Saturday visits are listed as being by appointment.
- The enquiry form is not a live appointment inventory or an instant booking confirmation.

[Clinic contact and consultation enquiries](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/contact-us)

## Denture Services

> An overview of the clinic's ten denture and dental-appliance service categories.

Source page: https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services

Content reviewed: 2026-10-13

The clinic's service overview links to complete dentures, partial dentures, implant-supported dentures, relines, rebase, denture repairs, adjustments, night guards, sports mouthguard and digital dentures.

New denture options and maintenance of existing dentures are presented separately. People unsure which service they need can request an assessment. The clinician reviews the existing appliance, mouth and patient concerns before recommending an option.

### Practical details

- Use the individual service pages for the relevant scope and enquiries.
- Costs and availability are confirmed by the clinic; no universal treatment price is stated here.

## Canadian Dental Care Plan Information

> The clinic's participation information and support for eligible Canadian Dental Care Plan patients.

Source page: https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/cdcp-coverage

Content reviewed: 2026-10-13

Ziaee Denture Clinic states that it participates in the Canadian Dental Care Plan and welcomes eligible patients. The website describes help checking coverage, explaining patient costs, submitting claims and handling pre-authorization where required.

Coverage should be checked for the specific patient and proposed service before treatment. This summary does not establish eligibility, approve a claim, or promise that any treatment is entirely free. The clinic and the current official plan information are the appropriate sources for those details.

### Practical details

- Ask the clinic what coverage documents to bring.
- Request a clear explanation of any patient charges and authorization requirements.
- Do not assume implant placement or every denture/appliance service is covered.

### Further information

- [Official Canadian Dental Care Plan](https://www.canada.ca/en/services/benefits/dental/dental-care-plan.html)

[Clinic contact and consultation enquiries](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/contact-us)

## Complete Dentures

> Custom complete dentures to replace a full upper or lower arch of missing teeth.

Source page: https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/complete-dentures

Content reviewed: 2026-10-13

The complete-denture page describes custom full dentures designed around the patient's mouth, gums and bite. This service is relevant to people seeking replacement of a full upper or lower set of teeth or replacement of existing full dentures.

The website discusses both conventional complete dentures and immediate-denture arrangements following extractions. The appropriate approach, timing and any coordination with another dental practitioner must be confirmed during assessment. Fitting and subsequent adjustments are part of the patient-care pathway described on the website.

### Practical details

- Discuss fit, appearance, bite and everyday use during consultation.
- Confirm treatment stages, costs and coverage before proceeding.
- No fixed lifespan, guaranteed fit or universal completion time is promised in this summary.

[Clinic contact and consultation enquiries](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/contact-us)

---

## Partial Dentures

> Custom removable partial dentures for people who have missing teeth and retain some natural teeth.

Source page: https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/partial-dentures

Content reviewed: 2026-10-13

The partial-denture service addresses replacement of some missing teeth with a removable appliance. The clinic describes matching the design to the patient's remaining teeth, mouth and appearance preferences.

The live page lists cast-metal, flexible and acrylic options. The suitability of a material or design depends on the examination and treatment discussion. The clinician reviews the mouth and patient's needs before proposing an option, and the clinic can discuss relevant coverage and patient costs.

### Practical details

- Ask which designs are appropriate for the assessed situation.
- Discuss fitting, care and any follow-up appointments with the clinic.

[Clinic contact and consultation enquiries](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/contact-us)

---

## Implant-Supported Dentures

> Custom dentures that attach to implants, with the denture pathway coordinated with dental surgeons.

Source page: https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/implant-supported-dentures

Content reviewed: 2026-10-13

The clinic's implant-supported denture page describes custom overdentures that attach to implants. It states that the clinic works with dental surgeons. The appliance may be discussed with patients seeking a different retention arrangement from conventional dentures.

The page mentions removable snap-on and bar-supported designs. Assessment determines the relevant option and the treatment pathway. Implant placement, healing and denture fitting are distinct stages; this summary does not identify the clinic as a provider of implant surgery. Fees and coverage for the implant and denture components should be clarified separately.

### Practical details

- Ask who performs each stage of treatment and how referrals are arranged.
- Confirm the intended appliance design, maintenance and costs.
- Eligibility, implant numbers, healing time and outcomes are individual assessment matters.

[Clinic contact and consultation enquiries](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/contact-us)

---

## Denture Relines

> Assessment and adjustment of the fitting surface of an existing denture, with hard and soft reline options described.

Source page: https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/relines

Content reviewed: 2026-10-13

The reline page describes updating the inner fitting surface of an existing denture. The clinic offers hard and soft reline options and reviews the appliance and the patient's mouth before recommending a method.

People experiencing a change in fit can enquire about an assessment rather than assuming they need a replacement denture. The live page discusses in-clinic laboratory processing, but the available turnaround depends on the case and appointment arrangements.

### Practical details

- A reline, rebase, repair and replacement are different services.
- The clinic determines which option is suitable after reviewing the denture.
- Confirm the time needed without the appliance and applicable costs or coverage.

[Clinic contact and consultation enquiries](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/contact-us)

---

## Denture Rebase

> Replacement of an existing denture's base while retaining its teeth when the appliance is suitable for rebasing.

Source page: https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/rebase

Content reviewed: 2026-10-13

The rebase service replaces the denture base rather than simply updating its inner fitting surface. The clinic describes retaining the existing prosthetic teeth when their condition and the appliance design make this appropriate.

The service page discusses impressions, laboratory work and a fitting check. An assessment is needed to decide whether rebasing, relining, repair or a new denture is the relevant option. Costs, laboratory time and follow-up arrangements should be confirmed with the clinic.

### Practical details

- Ask the clinician to explain why the proposed service fits the assessed condition of the denture.
- Coverage is checked for the patient and service; it is not guaranteed by this summary.

[Clinic contact and consultation enquiries](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/contact-us)

---

## Denture Repairs

> Professional repair enquiries for damaged denture bases, teeth and clasps, including additions to suitable partial dentures.

Source page: https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/denture-repairs

Content reviewed: 2026-10-13

The repair page lists work on cracked or broken bases, chipped or detached denture teeth, and damaged clasps. It also describes adding a tooth or clasp to a suitable partial denture after a change in the patient's natural teeth.

The website advertises same-day turnaround for many standard repairs. That is not a guarantee for every repair or an offer of 24-hour service. Patients should call to discuss the damage, appointment availability, repair conditions and expected completion time. Coverage and any charges are checked for the specific patient and service.

### Practical details

- Call 604-326-0459 to enquire about repair availability.
- The clinic assesses the denture before confirming the repair approach and timeline.
- Follow the clinic's repair instructions rather than modifying the appliance yourself.

[Clinic contact and consultation enquiries](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/contact-us)

---

## Denture Adjustments

> Assessment and adjustment of pressure points, bite and appliance fit for denture comfort.

Source page: https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/adjustments

Content reviewed: 2026-10-13

The adjustment page describes appointments to review denture fit, pressure points and bite. It includes work on complete, partial and implant-related denture designs, including enquiries about appliances made elsewhere.

The clinician identifies the relevant area and checks the appliance after any modification. An enquiry about discomfort does not establish its cause or the right treatment without examination. Patients should contact the clinic for appointment and follow-up arrangements.

### Practical details

- Confirm whether the appointment is for adjustment, reline, repair or another assessment.
- Ask the clinic about charges, included follow-up visits and coverage rather than assuming all adjustments are free.

[Clinic contact and consultation enquiries](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/contact-us)

---

## Custom Night Guards

> Custom-fitted night guard appliances, with design and fit assessed by the clinic.

Source page: https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/night-guards

Content reviewed: 2026-10-13

The clinic's night-guard page describes custom appliances for people enquiring about grinding or clenching. It lists different appliance styles and describes taking an impression or scan followed by a fitting appointment.

The relevant design and whether an appliance is appropriate are assessment matters. A night guard should not be represented as a guaranteed cure for grinding, pain or sleep problems. Patients can ask the clinic about suitability, maintenance, costs and any private-plan reimbursement.

### Practical details

- The reviewed service URL is /services/night-guards, using the plural form.
- Request appliance-specific care instructions from the clinic.

[Clinic contact and consultation enquiries](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/contact-us)

---

## Custom Sports Mouthguards

> Custom-fitted sports mouthguards for youth and adult athletes.

Source page: https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/sports-mouthguard

Content reviewed: 2026-10-13

The sports-mouthguard page describes appliances shaped to the athlete's teeth and bite. It mentions options for youth and adult patients, different protection levels and customization such as colours.

The clinic describes an impression and a fitting process. The sport, existing dental work, growth and appliance condition can be discussed during assessment. Patients should confirm availability, fabrication time, cost and any insurance reimbursement directly with the clinic.

### Practical details

- Ask the clinic which design is suitable for the sport and patient.
- No appliance eliminates all risk of a sports injury.

[Clinic contact and consultation enquiries](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/contact-us)

---

## Digital Dentures

> Dentures designed using digital scanning and computerized design, with manufacturing methods described on the clinic's service page.

Source page: https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/services/digital-dentures

Content reviewed: 2026-10-13

The digital-denture page describes a workflow using 3D scanning, digital design and computer-assisted crafting. It discusses storing the digital design in clinic records to support future duplication or replacement where appropriate.

The page lists digital approaches for complete dentures, partial dentures and implant overdentures. The clinic determines which methods are suitable for the patient. The number of appointments, fit adjustments, replacement process and fees are not identical for every case and should be discussed during consultation.

### Practical details

- Digital records are private clinic records and are not included in these public discovery files.
- Ask the clinic to explain the manufacturing method and treatment stages for the proposed denture.

[Clinic contact and consultation enquiries](https://www.ziaeedentureclinic.ca/contact-us)

Use the live index to find current articles. General care information supports understanding of services but does not replace an individual assessment or instructions for a specific appliance.
